fusions.name: Down the Length
fusions.desc: You sight along the staff and fire a ball of shot at the first enemy within 12 tiles, dealing 32 damage. It bursts on impact, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Muzzle Kick
fusions.desc: A blast of smoke and shot leaves the end of the staff through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Long Barrel
fusions.desc: You sight down the staff's length: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Powder Still Hot
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, the staff stays primed: your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
